meta.name: tfx-goal-clarify
meta.description: 자연어 아이디어를 Claude Code `/goal` 명령어 한 블록으로 변환하는 clarifier. 모호한 작업 설명을 받아 공식 3축(End state / Stated check / Constraints) + stop bound로 압축해 복붙 가능한 /goal 문자열을 출력. '/goal로 만들어', 'goal 프롬프트', 'goal 변환', 'clarify goal', 'goal 양식', '자율 작업 시작' 같은 요청에 사용.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法变成能直接使用的目标任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常用 Claude Code 交办复杂任务,却难把想法说清楚。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into crisp, actionable goal blocks for your coding agent.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Claude Code for complex jobs but often struggle to state what you need.

howto.what: 把用户随口说的目标改写成 Claude Code 的 /goal 命令块:先按 End state(完成标准)、Check(验证命令)、Constraints(不可改动项)三轴提问,再带上停止条件(如 20 轮),输出可直接粘贴的 /goal 文本。
howto.when: 当你说出「/goal로 만들어」「goal 변환」「clarify goal」等关键词,或请求把自然语言目标转换成 /goal 指令时触发。

say.text: 把「修复 auth 测试」转成 goal 指令
say.note: 会输出 /goal 块,默认 tier 2

say.text: 用 tier 1 把「测试全跑绿」做成 goal
say.note: 生成含停止轮数的简短 /goal 一行

say.text: 把「users 模块换新设计系统」整成 tier 3 goal
say.note: 会做 5~8 个追问再组装 9 段式 /goal

howto.what_en: Rewrites a vague natural-language goal into a Claude Code /goal block: it asks about End state, Check command and Constraints, adds a stop bound (e.g. 20 turns), then outputs a copy-paste-ready /goal string.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like '/goal로 만들어', 'goal 변환' or 'clarify goal', or ask to convert a natural-language idea into a /goal command.

say_en.text: Turn 'fix auth tests' into a goal command
say_en.note: Outputs a /goal block, tier 2 by default

say_en.text: Make 'get tests green' a goal with tier 1
say_en.note: Generates a one-line /goal with stop bound

say_en.text: Convert 'rework users module to new design system' into a tier 3 goal
